500570.name: Tata Motors Limited
examples: Aarogya (Health): child malnutrition programs, preventive/curative healthcare, health awareness for women, drinking water projects, strengthening health institutions
Vidyadhanam (Education): scholarships, remedial coaching, exam preparation support, school infrastructure development
Kaushalya (Employability/Skilling): skill development with ITIs in auto-mechanics, retail, hospitality, driver training
Learn and Earn programme enabled a Melghat tribal region woman to join JLR Slovakia facility after skilling on Harrier-Safari line
500570.notes: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Limited), Annexure-2 Board's Report FY26; Total amount spent for FY = ₹76.95 crore (₹76 cr projects + ₹1 cr admin overheads), Amount Unspent: Nil; excess spent ₹2 crore over 2% obligation of ₹75 crore.

SBIN.name: State Bank of India
examples: Upgraded infrastructure of 699 primary schools (₹24.45 crore) and 453 Primary Health Centres (₹7.01 crore) across India
CSR donation of ₹99.75 lakh for an Alcon Constellation Retina Surgery Machine to Midnapur Rotary Eye Hospital, West Bengal
CSR support of ₹176.49 lakh to Zilla Parishad Girls High School, Alapadu, Dist. Eluru (AP) for infrastructure upgrades including a science lab
CSR donation of ₹86.26 lakh for medical equipment at Bagchi Sri Shankara Cancer Centre & Research Institute, Bhubaneswar (Odisha)
SBIN.notes: Notes to accounts/Statutory Reports, pages 137-142 & 21; Total CSR Expenditure ₹709.01 crore for FY 2025-26 explicitly stated; no separate 2% statutory obligation, unspent, or gross obligation figures disclosed in excerpt (bank donates 1% of prior year profit per RBI guidelines, not standard Sec 135 2% formula figures shown).

RELIANCE.name: Reliance Industries Limited
examples: Reliance Foundation Scholarships supporting 5,100 students annually, mostly meritorious undergraduates from underprivileged backgrounds
Rural Transformation Program promoting climate-resilient agriculture, dairy, goatery, fisheries and non-farm livelihoods for rural communities
Digital Farm School (DFS) providing farmer-centric agricultural extension via digital and on-ground support
Women's empowerment initiative on digital literacy and financial inclusion
RELIANCE.notes: Annexure III, Annual Report on CSR Activities FY2025-26 (Board's Report); amounts as stated in ₹ crore, no conversion needed.
